description: Automatic version recommendation from conventional commit history. Starting from a current version recorded in the project manifest, the tool inspects the commit messages added since that version and selects the smallest semantic-version increment that covers them: a commit whose type marks a breaking change bumps the major component (resetting minor and patch to zero), a feature commit bumps the minor component (resetting patch), and a fix commit bumps the patch component. The reported value is the recommended next version. Input gives the starting version and the sequence of commit subject lines; output reports the computed next version.
